overall_goal: Prepare the sugar syrup, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce mixture in a saucepan

goals.rationale: The person retrieves the sugar container, gets a spoon, breaks apart the sugar, and scoops it into the saucepan.

goals.description: Retrieve and open the Worcestershire sauce and minced garlic
goals.rationale: The person gets the Worcestershire sauce and minced garlic jar, and removes the wrapper from the garlic jar to open it.

goals.description: Dissolve the sugar in the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person swills and stirs the sugar and water in the saucepan over the hob, adjusting the flame to dissolve the sugar.

goals.description: Add Worcestershire sauce to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person opens the Worcestershire sauce, measures a teaspoon, and pours it into the saucepan.

goals.description: Add minced garlic to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person opens the minced garlic jar, scoops out a teaspoon, and adds it to the saucepan.

goals.description: Stir the sauce mixture in the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the mixture in the saucepan and taps the spoon to remove excess food.
